scientific_integrity: Symbolic Cartier identities and a tame Prym eigenspace argument establish superspeciality for all smooth parameters; no independent review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only algebraic closures of characteristic-five fields; smooth parameters satisfy a^2 != 4.
No classification of polarizations, descent, or general cyclic-trigonal families.
Historical mathematical priority is not independently certified.
title: A uniformly superspecial Prym family in characteristic five
